title: Australian Frittata with Crisp Vegetables
description: A hearty and flavorful frittata filled with crispy vegetables and savory tofu, inspired by Australian cuisine.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the crispy vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked vegetables, tofu, and shredded cheese to the bowl. Stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate or skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
